title: Instrument cluster displays and warnings
summary: This topic centers on instrument cluster messages, layout options, and display preferences, with most excerpts describing features or requests without a clear overall sentiment.

negative.summary: The only clearly negative example is a drivetrain malfunction warning appearing on the instrument cluster at startup.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention service reminders, display estimates, available layouts, odometer visibility, launch and sport displays, and customer preferences for what should appear in the instrument cluster.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are classified as undetermined, so the sentiment evidence for this topic is limited.
